product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk provides an AI-powered business phone system and AI voice agents for small and mid-sized sales and support teams.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The technical blog has multiple product-development posts. Its article bylines label the authors Senior Copywriters, while their profiles identify them as CloudTalk's Director of Engineering and CPTO, respectively.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation and a help center with multiple guides are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Education Manager (AI-Enabled) posting has AI in its title; this is not represented as an AI/ML engineering role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI for Conversation Intelligence, Anthropic for AI Voice Agent configuration, Google for Speech-to-Text, and AssemblyAI for speech-to-text transcription.

last_funding.notes: The round was announced on January 17, 2024; the company profile lists it as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is the January 2024 Series B, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Sales Development Representative – Inbound posting was listed as posted October 15, 2026, with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: CloudTalk announced its AI Sales Dialer launch on November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership listing is marked unverified and shows only one person; no dated join or departure could be confirmed from a complete leadership roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An SDR job listing calls it “our HubSpot CRM system”; product integration listings are not treated as evidence of CloudTalk's internal CRM stack.
